2024-09-04.name: Murai no Koi
2024-09-04.desc:
* Based on a romantic comedy manga by Shima Junta

Murai is an introverted young high school student with a look that nobody notices. Long hair, curved gait, he is not really what one could call a beauty canon, nor even a person you want to dwell on... He shyly confesses to the girl he loves, the beautiful and sparkling Tanaka, an inveterate otaku who only has eyes for the characters in her games. However, she simply declines his feelings...

The next morning, Murai comes back to school transformed from head to toe. He has dyed and cut his hair and now wears the style of Tanaka's favourite character! Murai will do everything to seduce her and attract her attention!

Source: M-U

2024-09-06.name: Eiga Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai: Kanketsuhen

2024-09-07.name: Kankin Kuiki Level X
2024-09-07.desc:
Ryoka is awakened by flurry of text messages from her mother! Panicked and rushed, Mom is clearly concerned for Ryoka's safety, but she is not too keen on letting her daughter know why. Her reasoning being that nothing could really properly describe what is happening!

The world might be ending! And there might be a massive new life-form on the roof of their apartment building!

Source: Denpa

2024-09-13.name: Gekijouban Overlord: Sei Oukoku Hen
2024-09-13.desc:
Under the leadership of Sacred Queen Calca, the Roebel Sacred Kingdom enjoyed an era of peace, protected behind their great walls. However, that peace was easily destroyed by the sudden appearance of the Demon Emperor Jaldabaoth and the attack of the Demi-Human Alliance. Though the grandmaster of Roebel Sacred Kingdom’s Sacred Paladin Order, Remedios, and the high priestess, Kelart, gathered their forces to retaliate, they could not overcome the overwhelming difference in Jaldabaoth's power, and their kingdom is now on the verge of collapse. Remedios travels with her order and her subordinate, Neia, to a certain kingdom in hopes of gaining power to counter Jaldabaoth. The name of that kingdom is Sorcerer Kingdom Ainz Ooal Gown. It is a grotesque nation ruled by an undead and despised by those of the Sacred Kingdom—

Source: Kadokawa

2024-09-14.name: Wanmei Shijie: Juchang Ban
2024-09-14.desc:
The reunion of Huo Sang plays a sad song of sin and blood, and where the ashes fall, the stone spirit is reborn from despair.

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2024-09-14.name: Yishi Du Zun 2nd Season
2024-09-14.desc:
Lin Yun, a sword slave of Qingyun Sect of Tianshui Country, became extraordinary after being reborn. After a set of fierce tiger punches, he broke through to the third level of martial arts and became an outer disciple of the sect. However, even after getting rid of his sword slave status and becoming an outer disciple, Lin Yun was still discriminated against by other disciples of the sect. This was all because of the unwritten rule of "once a sword slave, always a sword slave"... The road of martial arts is full of hardships. How can Lin Yun constantly challenge himself, find opportunities for improvement, break the sect's prejudice, rewrite the fate of a sword slave, and step into the peak of martial arts?

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-09-20.name: Go-Toubun no Hanayome *
2024-09-20.desc: * Based on a comedy romance shounen manga series written and drawn by Haruba Negi.

2024-09-21.name: Tian Ying
2024-09-21.desc:
Lu Chen, the "Shadow" undercover agent of Fuyun Division, was cursed by black fire for destroying the demon sect's divine spell, and his cultivation was completely destroyed. After ten years of living in exile and seclusion, Master Tian Lan appeared again and gave Lu Chen the task of going to the Kunlun Sect to find the undercover demon sect. In order to repair the damaged Five Elements God Disk, Lu Chen was ordered to become a hundred of the Kunlun Sect. A handyman disciple in the thatched cottage. In the process of carrying out the mission, he met many friends and the love of his life Yi Xin, and gradually felt the warmth of the world. At the same time, he touched on the secrets behind Kunlun from various clues, and discovered that the black dragon sealed in the Kunlun Forbidden Land was not an evil monster, but had always claimed to be for The righteous Tian Lan actually had other plans. After realizing the facts, Lu Chen was confused for a while. With Yi Xin's encouragement, he decided to face the past and no longer stick to the so-called distinction between good and evil, but to follow his heart and do the right thing.

source: MAL

2024-09-22.name: Mahou Tsukai ni Narenakatta Onnanoko no Hanashi.
2024-09-22.desc:
Kurumi Mirai, a freshman in high school. In the Letran Magic and Magecraft School, the one institution that trains the top-class "wizards" of the International Mage Alliance, she has already secured top marks since middle school. And yet, when she reached high school and took the selection exam to get into the "Magic Group" class that trains wizards, she did not get in.

In the next class, there were students taking the test to become fully fledged wizards, and among them was a student whom Kurumi admired.

How will Kurumi adapt and grow with not being selected despite her boundless intellect? And what of the goals of the top-class wizard Minami Suzuki, Kurumi's new homeroom teacher?

Source: ANN

Note: The winner for the "Another World / Fantasy" category of Project ANIMA.

The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 22 September 2024 at Nippon Cultural Braodcasting Media Plus Hall in Tokyo which was also live streamed on Project ANIMA's YouTube channel. The regular TV broadcast started on 5 October 2024.

Additionally, episode 3 received an early screening at a special event on 14 October 2024 at Ritsumeikan University Kinugasa Campus in Kyoto.

2024-09-25.name: Man Huang Xian Jie
2024-09-25.desc:
In the vast and boundless world of immortals, the culture of cultivating immortals prevails, and mortals are proud to become monks. College student Lu Hangzhi traveled from modern times and became a mortal servant in Ziyun Town. He lived a life of walking on thin ice every day, but he refused to accept his fate and worked hard to get rid of the status quo and strive to get ahead. Later, because of a good deed, he was appreciated by Zhu Fuqin, the eldest lady of the Zhu Mansion, and his senior brother Leng Wuya, and was recruited into the Zhu Mansion to take the test. If he passed, he would have the opportunity to become a monk in Xuanxin Sect. Lu Hangzhi seized the opportunity to work hard and conscientiously completed all the tasks assigned by Zhu Fuqin. During this period, he occasionally got an unexpected opportunity. With the help of the five hundred-year-old spiritual fruit, he improved his qualifications and was highly valued by Zhu Fuqin. Zhu Fuqin felt that introducing Lu Hangzhi to Xuanxin Sect could increase his help, so he gave him many helping hands to help him grow rapidly. Lu Hangzhi did not disappoint. Through unremitting efforts, he finally passed the test and became an outer disciple of Xuanxin Sect. However, this is just the beginning. Lu Hangzhi's ambition goes far beyond this. He wants to go further. Only by being promoted to an inner disciple can he obtain more resources and ensure that he has enough strength to gain a foothold.

source: movie.douban.com/googletranslate

2024-09-27.name: Hitoribocchi no Isekai Kouryaku
2024-09-27.desc:
* Based on a comedy isekai light novel series written by Goji Shouji and illustrated by Enomaru Saku.

When sarcastic loner Haruka gets transported with his class to another world, he's not wild about adventuring, but he wouldn't mind having some cool powers. Unfortunately, he's last in line when the magic cheat skills get divvied up, so by the time it's Haruka's turn, there are no good choices left. Now Haruka will have to take on this fantasy world the hard way–on his own, with a hodgepodge of bizarre skills! When infighting and chaos break out among his classmates, can this loner come to the rescue?

Source: Seven Seas Entertainment

Note: The first episode premiered on 5 July 2024 at Anime Expo in Los Angeles. The regular broadcast started on 27 September 2024.

2024-09-28.name: Maou-sama, Retry! R
2024-09-28.desc:
* Based on a fantasy light novel series written by Kanzaki Kurone and illustrated by Iino Makoto.

Note: The first episode received an early screening at a special event on 23 September 2024 at Abema Anime Festival in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 28 September 2024.

2024-09-28.name: Wuhang Zhanshen 2
2024-09-28.desc:
A century-old sword, sharp enough to slash gods; once it is unsheathed, who can compete with it?
　　In the City of Ten Thousand Monsters, there are devilish dragons and fire monsters; a lone hero, Shi Huang, swears to protect the peace of the empire.
　　See how Shi Huang uses the power of a sword to cut off the shackles of fate and write a legend!

source: movie.douban.com

2024-09-29.name: Ao no Exorcist: Yuki no Hate Hen
2024-09-29.desc:
* Based on Katou Kazue's dark fantasy manga by the same name, serialised in Jump Square.

Note: The first episode received an advance release on U-NEXT, Hulu, and Docomo Anime Store on 29 September 2024. The regular TV broadcast started on 6 October 2024.

2024-09-29.name: Nageki no Bourei wa Intai Shitai
2024-09-29.desc:
It's the golden age for treasure hunters—adventurers hungry for wealth, fame, power, and glory, who risk their lives in treasure vaults throughout the world. "Let's become treasure hunters." Krai and his childhood friends swore to become the greatest of them all, but that dream should have died the day Krai realized he wasn't cut out for the job! Yet expectations continue to mount, right along with Krai's fear for his life. While his childhood friends climb closer toward their dream, this grieving soul has one simple wish: to pack it all in and retire!

Source: J-Novel Club

2024-09-29.name: Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru (2024)
Uzumaki
2024-09-29.desc:
* Based on a seinen supernatural horror manga series by Itou Junji.

Kurouzu-chou, a small fogbound town on the coast of Japan, is cursed. According to Saitou Shuuichi, the withdrawn boyfriend of teenager Goshima Kirie, their town is haunted not by a person or being but by a pattern: uzumaki, the spiral, the hypnotic secret shape of the world. It manifests itself in small ways: seashells, ferns, whirlpools in water, whirlwinds in air. And in large ways: the spiral marks on people's bodies, the insane obsessions of Shuuichi's father, the voice from the cochlea in your inner ear. As the madness spreads, the inhabitants of Kurouzu-chou are pulled ever deeper, as if into a whirlpool from which there is no return...

Source: VIZ

2024-09-30.name: Goukon ni Ittara Onna ga Inakatta Hanashi
2024-09-30.desc:
* Based on a love comedy manga by Aokawa Nana.

College student Tokiwa gets invited to a mixer by his female classmate Suou. But when he arrives with his friends, they're greeted by three dazzlingly handsome men?!

Source: Manga Up!

Note: The first two episodes received an early screening at a special event on 22 September 2024 at TOHO Cinemas Ikebukuro in Tokyo. The regular broadcast started on 30 September 2024.
